[[File:ProwCarving-ProwBeaten.png|thumb|right|upright|The Ewok prow carving was an important part of the Fishing Festival.]]
The '''Fishing Festival''' was a holiday observed by a [[Bright Tree Village tribe|tribe]] of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] who inhabited [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the festival was almost disrupted by a [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] [[Gorneesh's tribe|tribe]] led by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]] when the Duloks stole the Ewoks' [[prow carving]] and set course to plunder the Ewoks' [[Fish/Legends|fish]] with a [[Dulok battleship]]. However, the Ewoks [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], [[Latara/Legends|Latara]], and [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] foiled Gorneesh's plans with the help of a colony of [[skib]]s.
